name: airtrace-monorepo
description: AirTrace — Personal Air Quality Exposure Tracker (Monorepo: Backend & Frontend)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend dev"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm --prefix backend dev" "npm --prefix frontend dev"
